place_fields.summary: Gavimath is a historic spiritual institution in Koppal, associated with Sri Gavisiddheshwara Matha and a long-standing monastic tradition.
place_fields.best_time: January during the Gavisiddheshwara Jatre for the main festival atmosphere; regular visits are also possible.

planning_attributes.description: Gavimat is the Gavimath complex in Koppal, Karnataka, associated with Sri Gavisiddheshwara Samsthana and the Gavisiddheshwara Matha.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The official Gavimath site describes the institution as having a history of thousands of years and traces its tradition through successive peethadhipatis, including Sri Gavisiddheshwara.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The place is on Gavi Math Road in Koppal, Karnataka. Koppal is connected by road and rail; the math is within Koppal town.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.
